guidetextdraw_950791568._value:
The Concurrent Enrollment form is necessary ONLY when: 

  1. You are Pell grant eligible or Cal Grant Access eligible. 
  2. You are enrolled in 6 -11 units at Cal State Fullerton. 
  3. You HAVE NOT transferred 70 or more Community College units to Cal State Fullerton.
guidetextdraw_950791568.name: textdraw_9507915681673348318065

guidetextdraw_1769980569._value:
INSTRUCTIONS 

  • Completely fill out the student section. 
  • Obtain certification from the Registrar’s Office and the Aid Office at the other school you are attending.
  •  Return form to  CSU, Fullerton, Office of Financial Aid. 
  • Allow  3- 4 weeks  for your request to be processed 
  • Must submit 1 week prior to the end of semester.
  •  Form submitted after December 2nd will not be accepted.
